exact_answers.detail: R3 wrong (used P(A and B)=0 instead of max {0.56,0.74} bound), R7 wrong (placed robin 3rd), R10 wrong (said Yes).

rigor.detail: Most derivations sound; R5/R6 computed correctly; R10 subset enumeration incomplete.

clarity.detail: Clean notation, every Final Answer present and parseable.

functionality.detail: 7/10 requirements met: clock, cards, chart, feed, storage ok; sorting lacks desc indicator; countdown LANDED state missing.

visual_design.detail: Coherent dark theme, consistent tokens; generic but clean typography.

code_quality.detail: Single init entry point, decent helpers; intervals not cleaned on theme switch.

accessibility.detail: Landmarks and aria-labels present; focus styles visible; prefers-reduced-motion ignored.

responsive.detail: Wrap works 4-2-1; chart canvas fixed 480px wide on mobile.

spec_correctness.detail: Happy paths work; error envelope inconsistent on 404; DELETE on confirmed returns 409 correctly; missing date query filter.

security.detail: Input validation present; no body size limit; ids treated as opaque strings.

validation_errors.detail: Aggregates field errors; priority order respected except doctor check after parse.

data_modeling.detail: Separate maps, derived end at write time, immutable created_at.

design_answers.detail: D1 names transactions + unique exclusion; D3 token bucket justified; D4 DDL sketch solid; D5 honest failure mode (clock skew).
